scope: Destination recovery acknowledgement/release design trace; implementation pending
finding: REFRESH, FINAL and destination REVERSE use immediate post-command destination samples in _recordRecovery. _recoveryOwned can lose exact proof on later own acknowledgement. SIMPLE_BACK has distinct pre-input/turn acknowledgement and must remain separate.
releaseHazard: RecoveryRelease metadata-only retirement is appropriate for proven changed commands; it is not proof that an issued but unacknowledged rear command was rejected.
A finite wait timeout with unchanged pre-command state cannot authorize dropping reverse stop/cap provenance or replaying a rear command. Late acknowledgement remains possible.
Direct release/exclusion can run independently before next DrivingAssistStart observation; fixing only the normal tick leaves a separate cleanup gap.
Public releasePending/locality retention and releaseUnresolved hard-deadline handling already exist; use original lifetime, no replacement retry timer or new permanent controller.
requiredDesign: Record exact requested destination and pre-command seats/tasks/destinations with original acknowledgement deadline at the actual write boundary.
A single mode-aware read-only classification should distinguish own acknowledged target, original pending state, unchanged but unacknowledged expiry, and proven changed command.
Both normal step and independent cleanup must consume the same classification. Own acknowledgement may refresh proof but never replay movement, renew deadline or infer physical travel.
Unchanged expired reverse request must retain safety provenance as uncertainty; it cannot become movement success, fresh recovery or permission to redirect unknown native authority.
Changed route/seats/commands/external controller must continue to prevent stop/recall. Preserve SIMPLE_BACK receipt semantics and current physical rear geometry/damage/total-motion guards.
implementation: Shared read-only DrivingRecoveryCommandState classifies exact/issued OWNED, original PENDING, unchanged EXPIRED or LOST state without commands or renewed clocks.
REFRESH/FINAL and actual destination rear writers record original target/expiry/pre-command seats/tasks/destinations. Native SIMPLE_BACK does not use destination request.
Normal owner atomically consumes acknowledged request into actual receipts only under same current journal/route/cap. Pending blocks ordinary recovery writes and rear endpoint mutation.

Expired unchanged reverse uses existing bounded releasePending/cleanup path rather than fresh movement. Independent release classifies/consumes acknowledgement too; pending/expired unchanged reverse grants retention only, OWNED is required for stop/handback.
Existing cleanup ticket signature includes original request, preventing a successor request from borrowing old ticket authority. Original hard deadline and unresolved terminal policy retained.

validation.initialFindings: Existing source-expression contracts updated to trace explicit request payload, stronger owned gate and third expiry boundary; no cases added/removed.
validation.initialFullFinding: New shared helper required assignment to existing driving family source registry; acceptance/status/scores unchanged.

remaining: Native expectedDestination timing and actual reverse travel/stop/handback require physical evidence.
Distinct subordinate driver destination changes remain conservative ownership loss; no inferred intermediate-command origin.
Late same-value commands cannot reveal origin. Hard-deadline unresolved receipts retain provenance, not successful handback.
Normal/HC migration, delayed request replication, shutdown/exclusion and runtime overhead unverified.
Existing release observer may service additional pending-request tickets; bounded four-ticket service is retained, but incremental cost has not been measured.
